222-527-5295-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5295-8249.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

5686-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
5686-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 3.

3899-3951-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3899-3951-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

3629-6735-8089.easyPrerequisites:
Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
Your life total is even.
3629-6735-8089.description:
Activate Soul Channeling by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

3836-5078-6089.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Urza.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is level 2 or higher

1318-5352-7895.easyPrerequisites: You control a mana-producing permanent that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1318-5352-7895.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {6}{G}{U}, targeting Little Bear and a mana-producing permanent.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by paying {U}{U} and tapping it, copying Doppelgang, targeting Little Bear and a mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the copy of Doppelgang, creating two copies of Little Bear and the mana-producing permanent.
When the Little Bear tokens enter, they trigger, untapping Echo Mage and any other applicable permanent.
Holding priority, activate the two mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.
1318-5352-7895.notes: If desired, you may only resolve one trigger in step 4. This would allow the next iteration to target any other permanent instead of Little Bear. You can then use the second trigger to untap Echo Mage again and proceed.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

553-4668-7468.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Heliod, the Warped Eclipse.
In response, cast Swat Away by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

3617-7722-7843.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Elrond.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Walk from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

4399-4518-6626-7173.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Virulent Emissary trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-6626-7173.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

457-5078-5390-7729.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch and Forensic Gadgeteer trigger.
Resolve the Forensic Gadgeteer trigger, creating a Clue token.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

2267-2292-3240-6462.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Tormod triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-3033-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Vengeful Vampire enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Vengeful Vampire enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
413-3033-6972.notes: If Vengeful Vampire starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

1387-1500-2100-2633-7425.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Urabrask, Blood Funnel and Prismari Pianist trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Prismari Pianist trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

423-1437-3478-3819.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-3478-3819.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Cultivator Colossus spell three times.
Resolve the first Cultivator Colossus copy.
The Cultivator Colossus token enters the battlefield, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield, drawing a card, and choosing not to repeat the process.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-1437-3478-3819.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to the landfall card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1308-1563-2457-4460.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

4508-5880-6753-7223.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4067-6281-6893-7206.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
4067-6281-6893-7206.notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
4067-6281-6893-7206.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty {U}
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Dundoolin Weaver.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Dundoolin Weaver that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Dundoolin Weaver token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dundoolin Weaver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.

2921-4681-5170-6094.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

586-2146-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2558-2829-5727-6705.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Frog creature token.
When the Frog enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

67-4681-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide and up to one other creature with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1253-3995-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1253-3995-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Gyre Engineer's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2558-4659-5687-5688.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Judith, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Repeat.

586-2232-5778.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {2}{B}, plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers twice and Cloudstone Curio triggers once.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the first Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the second Priest of Gix trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Priest of Gix token's trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1641-2034-4055-4452.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

262-413-2178.notablePrerequisites: Elemental Mastery and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature with power 1 or greater that does not have summoning sickness.
262-413-2178.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
When the Elemental(s) enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies, the creature with Thornbite Staff attached triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
If the creature has power 2 or greater, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.

1339-2557-3265-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2557-3265-4871.description:
Activate Dockside Chef by paying {1}{B} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Dockside Chef ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

803-1806-2034-5072.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
"Sliver" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1806-2034-5072.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Eternal Scourge's encore ability by paying {3} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Eternal Scourge tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets infinite Eternal Scourge tokens with haste and colorless mana.

3490-4050-4362.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3490-4050-4362.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {1}.
The creature dies, triggering Orca's first ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat an arbitarily large number of times.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Orca, adding one mana of any color.
Orca dies, triggering its second ability, dealing infinite damage to any target(s).

1259-2104.notablePrerequisites: You do not have any instants or sorceries in your graveyard.
1259-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Charmbreaker Devils triggers, gaining +4/+0 until end of turn.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Charmbreaker Devils triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation to your hand.
Repeat.

224-2248-5233.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.
